layout.comment: derpy: the Zharr Exchange panel. Created at runtime into the campaign UI root by script/campaign/mod/zzz_derpy_chd_exchange.lua - no CA file is overridden. The 40 trade ritual cards are HIDDEN from CA's rites panel with SetVisible(false) so they stop crowding the Hell-Forge commissions - cm:lock_ritual does not remove them - and the trade runs here as cm:treasury_mod plus cm:faction_add_pooled_resource, because cm:perform_ritual never charges the treasury. Generated by tools/gen_exchange_ui.py; do not hand-edit.

btn_help.componentleveltooltip: What the panel means||Every column, symbol and view explained, with what holding goods costs and what it earns.

derpy_chd_ex_prev.componentleveltooltip: Previous view||Back one. The four trading views wrap, so this reaches the last of them from the first.

nav_page.componentleveltooltip: Which view||Where you are in the four trading views. The guide is not one of them - it has its own button, and it comes back to the view you left.

derpy_chd_ex_mode.componentleveltooltip: Next view||Trading, ownership, offerings and houses: who produces each commodity, who controls it, and what that control adds to the price.

ord_side.componentleveltooltip: Buy or sell||Switch this standing order between buying and selling.

ord_cmp.componentleveltooltip: At or below / at or above||Whether the order fires once the price falls to this level, or once it rises to it.

ord_down.componentleveltooltip: Adjust the price||Move the order's target one rung up or down the same ladder every price on this board sits on.

ord_up.componentleveltooltip: Adjust the price||Move the order's target one rung up or down the same ladder every price on this board sits on.

ord_place.componentleveltooltip: Place the order||Stands until the price crosses the level shown, then fills automatically on a later turn.

btn_amt_down.componentleveltooltip: One lot at a time||The button between these cycles the round sizes. Use these to reach the ones in between.

btn_amount.componentleveltooltip: Amount per click||How many lots a Buy or Sell moves, and the size a new standing order is placed at. Cycles 1, 5, 10, 25; the - and + beside it step one lot at a time. A lot is 10 of a commodity, 100 of Armaments or Raw Materials, 5 of a house share.

btn_amt_up.componentleveltooltip: One lot at a time||The button between these cycles the round sizes. Use these to reach the ones in between.

ord_qty_down.componentleveltooltip: One lot at a time||The button between these cycles the round sizes. Use these to reach the ones in between.

ord_qty.componentleveltooltip: Amount per click||How many lots a Buy or Sell moves, and the size a new standing order is placed at. Cycles 1, 5, 10, 25; the - and + beside it step one lot at a time. A lot is 10 of a commodity, 100 of Armaments or Raw Materials, 5 of a house share.
